note: SITC (Standard International Trade Classification) is a UN recommended nomenclature of goods. It is hierarchical from 1-level digit to 5-level digit. SITC is based upon CN8-kodes. Since all CN8-codes do not use quantity other then metric tons (or it is accounted in different sorts, square meter, gram etc) this is not available in SITC. The current SITC (revision 4) is used since January 2007. SITCrev 3 is an older version.

891: Statistics in commodity group Arms and Ammunition (SITC 891, SPIN 29.6, 29.60 and 29.600) must be interpreted with care. It is not to be used as an estimate on Swedish trade in goods for military and defence use. Included in the commodity group are both arms and ammunition for civilian as military use. Not included in the commodity group are Aircrafts, ships, vehicles, search- and measuring systems etc. for military use. The commodity group therefore consists of only a small amount in what is considered as goods for military and defence use. Complete statistics on goods for military and defence use is provided by Swedish Agency for Non-proliferation and Export controls (ISP).
